1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan
Pengurusan Strata (Pengkompaunan Kesalahan) 2019.

 (2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 2 Mei 2019.

Kesalahan yang boleh dikompaun

2.        (1) Kesalahan yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Pertama ditetapkan sebagai
kesalahan yang boleh dikompaun.

(2) Kesalahan yang boleh dikompaun itu boleh dikompaun dengan keizinan
bertulis Pendakwa Raya dalam Borang 1 Jadual Kedua.

Tawaran dan penyetujuterimaan kompaun

3. (1) Suatu tawaran untuk mengkompaun kesalahan hendaklah dibuat dalam
Borang 2 Jadual Kedua.

 (2)  Seseorang yang menyetuju terima tawaran untuk mengkompaun suatu
kesalahan yang boleh dikompaun hendakla h menyetuju terima tawaran itu dalam
Borang 3 Jadual Kedua.

Cara mengkompaun

4.  (1)  Selepas suatu penyiasatan dijalankan dan didapati bahawa suatu
kesalahan yang boleh dikompaun telah dilakukan, Pesuruhjaya boleh mengeluarkan
suatu Notis Tawaran untuk Mengkompaun Kesalahan dalam Borang 2 Jadual Kedua.

 (2) Tawaran untuk mengkompaun suatu kesalahan adalah sah bagi tempoh
empat belas hari, dan jika pembayaran penuh bagi jumlah yang ditawarkan itu dibuat
dalam tempoh empat belas hari itu, tiada pro siding selanjutnya boleh diambil terhadap
orang yang telah melakukan kesalahan itu.

 (3) Jika tiada pembayaran bagi kompaun yang telah ditawarkan itu dibuat
pada atau sebelum habis tempoh masa yang dinyatakan dalam subperaturan (2),
pendakwaan boleh dimulakan tanpa notis selanjutnya.

Pembayaran kompaun

5.  (1)    Jika suatu tawaran untuk mengkompaun kesalahan disetuju terima oleh
orang yang kepadanya tawaran itu dibuat, dia hendaklah membayar kompaun itu—

(a) secara tunai;

(b) melalui kiriman wang, kiriman wang  pos, pesanan juruwang,
pesanan bank atau draf bank dipalang dengan perkataan "Akaun
Penerima Sahaja" yang kena dibayar kepada Pesuruhjaya; atau

(c) melalui pemindahan wang secara elektronik.

 (2)  Pembayaran kompaun hendaklah diserahkan sendiri atau dihantar melalui
pos berdaftar bayar dahulu ke alamat yang dinyatakan dalam Notis Tawaran untuk
Mengkompaun Kesalahan.

 (3) Tiap-tiap pembayaran kompaun yang diterima hendaklah didepositkan
ke dalam akaun Kumpulan Wang Disatukan Negeri atau Kum pulan Wang Disatukan
Persekutuan, mengikut mana-mana yang berkenaan.

 (4) Suatu resit rasmi hendaklah dikeluarkan bagi tiap -tiap pembayaran yang
diterima di bawah subperaturan (1) kepada orang yang kepadanya tawaran untuk
mengkompaun itu telah dibuat.

 (5) Suatu resit rasmi yang dikeluarkan bagi maksud subperaturan (4)
hendaklah termasuk apa-apa resit elektronik yang dikeluarkan jika pembayaran dibuat
melalui pemindahan wang secara elektronik.

STRATA MANAGEMENT ACT 2013

STRATA MANAGEMENT (COMPOUNDING OF OFFENCES)
REGULATIONS 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 150(2) (e) of the
Strata Management Act 2013 [ Act 757 ], the Minister, after consultation with the
National Council for Local Government, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Strata Management
(Compounding of Offences) Regulations 2019.

 (2) These Regulations come into operation on 2 May 2019.

Compoundable offences
2. (1) The offences specified in t he First Schedule are prescribed to be
compoundable offences.

 (2) The compoundable offences may be compounded with the consent in
writing of the Public Prosecutor in Form 1 of the Second Schedule.

Offer and acceptance of compound
3. (1) An offer to compound an offence shall be made in Form 2 of the
Second Schedule.

 (2) A person who accepts an offer to compound a compoundable offence shall
accept the offer in Form 3 of the Second Schedule.

Method of compounding
4.  (1) After an investigation has been conducted and it is found that
a compoundable offence has been committed, the Commissioner may issue a Notice of
Offer to Compound Offence in Form 2 of the Second Schedule.

 (2) The offer t o compound an offence shall be valid for a period of fourteen
days, and if full payment of the sum offered is made within the period of fourteen days,
no further proceedings shall be taken against the person who committed such offence.

 (3) If no payment of the compound offered is made on or before the expiry of
the period stated in subregulation (2), prosecution may be instituted without further
notice.

Payment of compound
5.  (1)  If an offer to compound an offence is accepted by the person to whom the
offer is made, he may pay the compound—

(a) by cash;

(b) by money order, postal order, cashier's order, banker's order or
bank draft crossed with the words "Account Payee Only" made
payable to the Commissioner; or

(c) through electronic fund transfer.

(2) The payment of compound shall be delivered personally or sent by prepaid
registered post to the address specified in the Notice of Offer to Compound Offence.

(3) Every payment of compound received shall be deposited into the State
Consolidated Fund or the Federal Consolidated Fund, as the case may be.

(4) An official receipt shall be issued for every payment received under
subregulation (1) to the person to whom the offer to compound is made.

(5) An official receipt issued for the purpose of subregulation (4) shall include
any electronic receipt issued if the payment is made through electronic fund transfer.

FIRST SCHEDULE
[Subregulation 2(1)]

COMPOUNDABLE OFFENCES

The following offences are prescribed to be offences which may be compounded:

(a) the offences committed under the provisions of the Strata Management Act 2013
